lecciones.titulo: F and J: the index fingers
lecciones.objetivo: Learn the keys F, J with the left index finger and the right index finger. Without looking at the keyboard.
lecciones.tip: The F and J keys have a small raised bump. They help your index fingers always find their “home” without looking.

lecciones.titulo: D and K: the middle fingers
lecciones.objetivo: Learn the keys D, K with the left middle finger and the right middle finger. Without looking at the keyboard.
Review what you learned so your fingers remember it on their own.

lecciones.titulo: S and L: the ring fingers
lecciones.objetivo: Learn the keys S, L with the left ring finger and the right ring finger. Without looking at the keyboard.
Learn the keys A, Ñ with the left pinky and the right pinky. Without looking at the keyboard.
lecciones.tip: The pinkies are the weakest fingers. Go slowly: accuracy comes first.

lecciones.objetivo: Review what you learned so your fingers remember it on their own.

lecciones.objetivo: Learn the keys G, H with the left index finger and the right index finger. Without looking at the keyboard.
lecciones.tip: Your index fingers stretch a little toward the center and then go back to their home key.
